module.summary: Fixed-capacity integer-slot allocator backed by the repository fixed bit set.
module.long_description: Fixed-capacity integer-slot allocator backed by the repository fixed bit set.
module.support_policy: Experimental modules remain available but may change through semantic contract versioning.

purpose.primary: Allocate and free integer slot indices while detecting exhaustion, out-of-range release, and double free.

c_pain.summary: Raw bitmaps and freelists commonly leave free-versus-used meaning, bounds, and double release as scattered conventions.
c_pain.why_c_is_attractive: A bitmap is compact and maps directly to bit operations.
c_pain.where_c_degrades: Every caller can reinterpret bit meaning or bypass the allocation transition rules.

zig_response.summary: Compose the existing checked BitSet behind an allocator API with explicit errors.
remaining_programmer_responsibilities: associate returned indices with actual storage

agent_contract.summary: Fixed-capacity integer-slot allocator backed by the repository fixed bit set.
use_when: Allocate and free integer slot indices while detecting exhaustion, out-of-range release, and double free.
do_not_use_when: Need byte allocation, variable-sized blocks, or runtime growth.

free or reset: allocated index: index no longer denotes an allocated slot
